reviews.title: Restore purchase option does not work
reviews.text: The app has been inconsistent since my purchase. There is no clear method for accessing support in the app. My attempt to restore purchase after initial installation resulted in lifetime premium subscription price added to an app that frequently malfunctions

reviews.title: No bell sounds
reviews.text: The Bell does not sound at random times.

reviews.title: Re-install
reviews.text: It has to be deleted and be re-installed frequently.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: I use this several years ago and it worked great. I’ve tried installing it and reinstalling it recently and no bell sounds no matter what  bell  I pick. …

reviews.title: Exactly what I want, but seems broken
reviews.text: I can’t get the basic timer working.

reviews.title: Have to have phone screen on
reviews.text: If my phone is not open, the bell doesn’t ring. What good is that?

reviews.title: Not working
reviews.text: It stopped working after the first day

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: I’ve tried- I’ve messed around with all the ways you can set up the timer. The start button doesn’t function in the main section so you have to go on to the timer section to get it to start. Set it to ring every ten minutes. Rings once then that’s it. Whatever I do it will only ring once. Really annoyed I paid for the upgrade, such as it is. Ditch this and go for insight timer

reviews.title: Worked until I upgraded
reviews.text: Disappointed. Who knew no bells would sound upon upgrading. I should stuck with the free bells.

reviews.title: Does not work, no support available
reviews.text: I used this years ago and loved it. Keep trying to come back, the settings that the developers say we have to use in order for it to work make no difference and the website offers no contact. Fix it please!

reviews.title: App not working
reviews.text: The app isn't working (despite having paid for the bell) and there is nowhere to get assistance from. Disappointing.

reviews.title: Craptastic
reviews.text: Wonky uncooperative waste I need meditation after trying to make it work

reviews.title: Bugs
reviews.text: Good idea but bell sounds shut off abruptly after a few seconds which is annoying. Much better if it would slowly die out rather than suddenly

reviews.title: Subscription Version Doesn't work
reviews.text: Choice of Sounds defaults to the default version of the app. It needs to be upgraded to the current version of the iOS. Otherwise one is just wasting their two dollars. There is no direct response from support within the app and results in a complicated response from Apple Support.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: FAQ page turns into an error page so I can’t figure it out. Went through all settings. Notifications on, app allowed, volume on and still won’t ding. And what is the deal with the 15 notifications? Uninstalling.
